Go home Republic scum!''<nowiki></nowiki>|translated=1|Gorgol after his initial victory against the Republic on the Tambor Deep Space Centre|<ref name="The Droid Deception">{{TCWComicCite|6.4|The Droid Deception}}</ref>}}
'''Gorgol the Handy''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] aristocrat who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At that time, he had sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in their fight against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. This Geonosian was a notably skilled mechanic and was placed in charge of the [[Tambor Deep Space Centre]] which was servicing the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]. It was the efforts of this mobile [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] that aided [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in striking [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] positions throughout known space.

This eventually led to the Republic dispatching [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] along with [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Ponds/Legends|Ponds]] and [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] to assault the facility. They, along with their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] detachments, managed to board the station, but were ambushed by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces that were attached to the station as Gorgol's security forces. Gorgol the Handy later used his controller to remotely activate the deep space center's defenses which allowed him to eliminate the clone known as [[Swift (clone trooper)|Swift]] as well as his group of [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT]] troopers. This later prompted an apparent surrender from the Republic forces which Gorgol was willing to accept as he believed he would be rewarded by General Grievous, but discovered that it was a carefully laid out trap. Ambushed by the remaining Republic soldiers and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Gorgol attempted to flee but was caught in the sight of Commander Cody's blaster. Rather than kill Gorgol, the clone simply destroyed his controller. Gorgol was arrested with the intention of him being placed in a detention center for his crimes.
